# Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if present.

## Validation

List the checks run and any platform or workload limitations.

- [ ] Relevant behavior tests and checks pass.
- [ ] User guidance, field help and changelog reflect behavior changes, or their absence is explained.
- [ ] Screenshots were reviewed when controls or workflows changed.
- [ ] Technical contracts were updated in their owning guide and checked against the code.
- [ ] Release links and dated evidence keep their version and scope clear.
- [ ] Documentation checks pass for Markdown changes.
